goal: minimize model action entropy while making mutation and verification transitions evidence-driven
gates: model-visible frontier contains at most one actionable tool per execution state
LOCATE exposes only search; MUTATE/REPAIR expose only execute_patch; DONE/SAFE_FAIL expose no tools
ready Scout handoff may transition to MUTATE only after edit-capsule-v1 contextualizes every handoff file with strong fingerprints
edit capsule is persisted with source scope/evidence context and SHA-256 and is linked from the patch receipt
proof-obligation-v1 maps verifier checks to repair, rescout or fatal dispositions instead of treating every verifier failure as terminal
fatal proof failures include changed-file escape, replay mismatch, parse failure and verification worktree cleanup failure
rename syntactic closure failure returns to LOCATE; repairable conservation/cardinality failures permit at most one bounded repair
patch-executor-v2, patch-compiler-v1 and invariant-verifier-v1 sources remain byte-identical
three real repositories must complete search -> execute_patch -> final in exactly three model calls with one search and one patch attempt
private_repo, django and typescript main checkouts remain unchanged
